title: EHR Downtime — Downtime Declaration Requested

caller.name: Gail Moreau
caller.label: Night Nursing Supervisor, 4 West, 5 East, ICU 3N, ED

transcript.speaker: Gail Moreau
transcript.text: CNO, it's Gail Moreau on nights. The EHR won't open on 4 West, 5 East, ICU 3 North, or in the ED. eMAR is frozen, and 06:00 medications are due on every unit. The last printed medication packet is from 01:00. IT says they're looking at it. Do I declare downtime or wait for IT?

transcript.speaker: Carol Beckett
transcript.text: Gail, declare downtime now. Follow the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex, Section 2. Open the downtime cart on each unit, issue the DT-20260303-001 block, and activate the paper workflow. Use BCA-VIEW01 for active orders and allergies. The 06:00 meds go out from the pharmacist-checked list. I'll page the hospital.

instructorNote: This inject triggers the formal downtime declaration. The CNO must act decisively to prevent medication delays. Watch for hesitation or over-reliance on IT.
